programme.title: Crocodile Dundee II
programme.desc: Mick "Crocodile" Dundee (Paul Hogan) is settling into his new Manhattan home when a South American drug dealer (Hechter Ubarry) abducts his girlfriend, Sue Charlton (Linda Kozlowski). The drug dealer thinks images of his criminal activities, taken by Sue's photographer ex-husband, are now in her hands. The dealer takes Sue to Colombia and threatens her, hoping that she'll give up the evidence. But intrepid Dundee, aiming to rescue Sue, is soon on the criminal's trail. - Paul Hogan, Linda Kozlowski, Charles Dutton, John Meillon, Ernie Dingo (Comedy)

programme.title: Iron Eagle
programme.desc: When Col. Ted Masters' (Tim Thomerson) plane goes down in an Arab country, and he's sentenced to death for trespassing, his 18-year-old son, Doug (Jason Gedrick), is determined to save him. Unfortunately, Doug isn't the best fighter pilot -- he wasn't accepted into the Air Force because he needs to listen to music in order to hit a target. So he enlists the help of Col. Chappy (Louis Gossett Jr.) to borrow a couple of F-16 planes, fly across the Atlantic and start a rescue mission. - Louis Gossett Jr., Jason Gedrick, David Suchet, Tim Thomerson, Larry B. Scott (Action)

programme.title: A Few Good Men
programme.desc: Lt. Daniel Kaffee (Tom Cruise) is a military lawyer defending two U.S. Marines charged with killing a fellow Marine at the Guantánamo Bay Naval Base in Cuba. Although Kaffee is known for seeking plea bargains, a fellow lawyer, Lt. Cdr. JoAnne Galloway (Demi Moore), convinces him that the accused marines were most likely carrying out an order from a commanding officer. Kaffee takes a risk by calling Col. Nathan R. Jessep (Jack Nicholson) to the stand in an effort to uncover the conspiracy. - Tom Cruise, Jack Nicholson, Demi Moore, Kevin Bacon, Kiefer Sutherland (Drama)

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. - Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin, Scott Glenn, Sam Neill, James Earl Jones (Thriller, Action, Adventure)

Simpson), is shot, Frank sets out to find the culprit, leading him to business tycoon Vincent Ludwig (Ricardo Montalban). Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). O'Connor, Ciarán Hinds, Dillon Freasier (Drama)

programme.title: Yes, Minister S1 E7
programme.desc: Jobs for the Boys Jim talks up his involvement in a public-private partnership project, not knowing the financial irregularities that could lead to land him in hot water. The only way out seems to give a part-time government appointment that he is trying to abolish. ACTOR(s): Paul Eddington, Nigel Hawthorne, Derek Fowlds, Brian Hawksley, Arthur Cox - DIRECTOR(s): Sydney Lotterby (Sitcom, Politics)

programme.title: Yes, Minister S2 E1
programme.desc: The Compassionate Society The Minister sees an opportunity to further his career when a newly built and fully staffed hospital seems to have no patients. ACTOR(s): Derek Fowlds, Paul Eddington, Nigel Hawthorne, Arthur Cox, John Barron, Norman Bird, Rosemary Frankau, Stephen Tate - DIRECTOR(s): Peter Whitmore (Sitcom, Politics)

programme.title: Yes, Minister S2 E2
programme.desc: Doing the Honours Jim Hacker plans to block honours for civil servants until cost-cutting measures are introduced in their departments. Naturally, Sir Humphrey plans his own retaliation. ACTOR(s): Paul Eddington, Nigel Hawthorne, Derek Fowlds, Frank Middlemass, John Nettleton, James Fox, John Pennington, Margo Johns - DIRECTOR(s): Peter Whitmore (Sitcom, Politics)

programme.title: Bangers and Cash S6 E9
programme.desc: Burlington Arrow/Vauxhall Cresta Paul picks up a stunning 1961 Vauxhall Cresta, Dave drools over a Ford Sierra Sapphire Cosworth, and Derek refuses a test drive in the world's smallest production car, the 3.5 horsepower Peel P50. ACTOR(s): Derek Mathewson, Paul Mathewson, Dave Mathewson - PRODUCER(s): Andy Joynson, Kirsty Hanson (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Bangers and Cash S6 E10
programme.desc: Rover 3500/Citroen H Van Derek inspects a collection of old police cars that includes a Rover P6 complete with radio, sirens and V8 engine. Meanwhile, Paul tries to figure out who will buy an old 1975 Range Rover that has been converted into a fire engine. ACTOR(s): Derek Mathewson, Paul Mathewson, Dave Mathewson - PRODUCER(s): Andy Joynson, Kirsty Hanson, Paul Greenan (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys S12 E3
programme.desc: West Ruislip to Windsor Michael Portillo heads for leafy Hatch End, where he investigates an illustrator whose work was so popular in the 1920s and 30s that his name entered the English dictionary. William Heath Robinson's great-nephew talks Michael through some of the mad contraptions the artist used to satirise technology. ACTOR(s): Michael Portillo - DIRECTOR(s): Tom Richardson - PRODUCER(s): John Comerford (Documentary, Travel)

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys S14 E4
programme.desc: Wakefield to Leeds From Wakefield, West Yorkshire, Michael visits the National Coal Mining Museum for England at Caphouse Colliery. He pauses to admire the tall spire of Wakefield Cathedral and its resident peregrine falcons before heading to the banks of the Calder. ACTOR(s): Michael Portillo - DIRECTOR(s): Anthony Holland - PRODUCER(s): John Comerford (Documentary, Travel)

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment. (Shopping, Consumer)

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys S12 E4
programme.desc: Guildford to Aldershot Michael Portillo resumes his tour of the Home Counties in the picturesque and historic county town of Guildford. His 1936 Bradshaw's guide commends its 'fine old castle keep' and guildhall but makes no mention of its hilltop cathedral. Michael meets head guide Janet Matthews to discover the origins of the first Anglican cathedral to be built on a new site in the south of England since the Reformation, begun in 1936. ACTOR(s): Michael Portillo - DIRECTOR(s): Tom Richardson - PRODUCER(s): John Comerford (Documentary, Travel)

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys S14 E5
programme.desc: Bradford to Hebden Bridge Michael Portillo continues his post-war exploration of North West England in Bradford, Shipley and Hebden Bridge. In Centenary Square in Bradford, Michael encounters the literary giant JB Priestley, author of `An Inspector Calls'. ACTOR(s): Michael Portillo - DIRECTOR(s): Anthony Holland - PRODUCER(s): John Comerford (Documentary, Travel)

programme.title: Great American Railroad Journeys S2
programme.desc: Illinois to Tennessee Michael stops at rural Mattoon, where he gets a taste of the tough early life, which shaped President Abraham Lincoln. Wiping the sweat from his brow, Michael struggles to split one rail compared with Lincoln's estimated 700-a-day. ACTOR(s): Michael Portillo - PRODUCER(s): Alison Kreps, John Comerford (Documentary, Travel)

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Industrial Age S1 E5
programme.desc: Railways Fred's fascinating journey through Britain's industrial past sees him tracing the development of the railways, from the first steam locomotive to the record-breaking Mallard. The excitement reminds him of his childhood days when locomotives used to roar past his bedroom window, and Fred gets his hands dirty stoking the boiler of a Black Five as he speeds through the Welsh countryside. ACTOR(s): Fred Dibnah - DIRECTOR(s): David Hall - PRODUCER(s): David Hall (Documentary, History)

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Industrial Age S1 E6
programme.desc: Ships and Engineering Fred moves on to the golden age of shipbuilding, examining the skills of engineers who turned Britain into one of the foremost manufacturing nations. He also visits the world's first production line in Suffolk. ACTOR(s): Fred Dibnah - DIRECTOR(s): David Hall - PRODUCER(s): David Hall (Documentary, History)

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: The Early Pioneers Fred visits Cornwall to explore its key place in the early history of the steam engine. In Cornwall, Fred illustrates how the county's tin mining industry utilised steam engines to pump water. ACTOR(s): Fred Dibnah - PRODUCER(s): David Hall (History, Science)

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: The Age of the Steam Locomotive Fred Dibnah explores the revolutionary impact of steam engines on rail transport. In the process, Fred examines both the earliest colliery railways and the end of steam power on commercial railways in the 1960s. ACTOR(s): Fred Dibnah - PRODUCER(s): David Hall (History, Science)

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of America S1 E2
programme.desc: Episode 2 Martin's travels take him 1,500 miles to the San Juan Islands in Washington State, just off America's North West Pacific coast, right on the border with Canada. There are more than 100 islands, mostly uninhabited. From the San Juan Islands, Martin travels down America's West coast to visit the Channel Islands National Park, which is known as `America's Galápagos' because of its unique wildlife. From the Channel Islands, Martin takes a 2,000-mile journey across the States to Louisiana. ACTOR(s): Martin Clunes - DIRECTOR(s): Tom McCarthy - PRODUCER(s): Bill Jones, Philippa Braithwaite, Ian Leese (Documentary, Travel)

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Man to Manta
programme.desc: Actor Martin Clunes has been a keen surface diver for over ten years and he has a deep fascination for manta rays. Boasting a wingspan of 25 feet, manta rays are one of the most mysterious and gentle giants of the ocean. ACTOR(s): Martin Clunes (Documentary, Natural World)

programme.title: David Jason's Great British Inventions S1 E4
programme.desc: Episode 4 Sir David finds out about the invention of the incandescent light bulb, the world's first lawnmower and the development of the telephone, as he learns about the British innovations that have transformed our homes. ACTOR(s): David Jason - PRODUCER(s): Stuart Ramsay, Mark Robinson (Documentary, Technology)

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service S1 E1
programme.desc: Episode 1 Passionate espionage enthusiast Sir David Jason searches for the origins of the British Secret Service and discovers the legendary characters, audacious missions and makeshift methods that characterised the early days of spying. ACTOR(s): David Jason (Documentary, Crime)

programme.title: Operation Arctic with Simon Reeve S1 E2
programme.desc: The Changing Arctic Gordon meets the Polar Bear Cops tasked with keeping the town safe. Kate heads to Sweden to help round up some reindeer and Simon joins the intrepid NASA scientists monitoring the melt of Greenland's glaciers. Plus, all the live action from the bears out on the tundra. ACTOR(s): Gordon Buchanan, Kate Humble, Simon Reeve - PRODUCER(s): Lisa Ausden, Sarah Gibbs (Documentary, Natural World)

programme.title: Operation Arctic with Simon Reeve S1 E3
programme.desc: The People of the Arctic Kate meets the Inuit artists inspired by the changing world around them, while Simon heads off on a fishing expedition, Arctic style. In Churchill, Gordon finds out how the town deals with their more troublesome bears when he follows the eviction of a repeat offender. ACTOR(s): Gordon Buchanan, Kate Humble, Simon Reeve - PRODUCER(s): Lisa Ausden, Sarah Gibbs (Documentary, Natural World)

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries S2 E4
programme.desc: Stratford-upon-Avon to Birmingham On the last leg of his journey across England, Robbie crosses an epic aqueduct near Stratford-upon-Avon and gets stuck in a lock in central Birmingham. ACTOR(s): Robbie Cumming - PRODUCER(s): Stuart Woodman, Tony Parker (Travel, Boating)

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries S3 E1
programme.desc: Wigan to Burnley Narrowboater Robbie Cumming begins his 170-mile journey across the north of England and soon runs into difficulty when he encounters a propeller problem in Wigan and runs aground in Blackburn. Nevertheless, he pushes on to navigate a true wonder of the waterways: the Burnley Embankment. ACTOR(s): Robbie Cumming - PRODUCER(s): Stuart Woodman, Tony Parker (Travel, Boating)

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries S3 E2
programme.desc: Barrowford to Bingley Narrowboater and film-maker Robbie Cumming crosses the Pennines on the picturesque Leeds and Liverpool Canal, and lends a hand to hire boaters in Gargrave, North Yorkshire. He also encounters Bingley Five Rise Locks, a wonder of the inland waterways. ACTOR(s): Robbie Cumming - PRODUCER(s): Stuart Woodman, Tony Parker (Travel, Boating)

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries S3 E3
programme.desc: Dowley Gap to Ferrybridge Jump on board with narrowboater Robbie Cumming as he explores the Victorian village of Saltaire on the Leeds and Liverpool Canal, moors up in Leeds and goes in search of an abandoned waterway on the Aire and Calder Navigation.
